proposed_widenings.name: passive_on_hit_rider_for_non_mastery_units
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item mechanics families only cover always-on passive grants and resource-based activations. Vicious Weapon is an always-armed on-hit rider that adds extra damage when the wielder hits with the weapon, which requires a trigger-coupled subgraph rather than a static grant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This magic weapon deals an extra 2d6 damage to any creature it hits.

proposed_widenings.name: weapon_damage_type_reference
proposed_widenings.justification: The extra damage is not a fixed damage type. It inherits the struck weapon's normal damage type, and the current surface only supports fixed damage types or author-time/cast-time choices.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This extra damage is of the same type as the weapon's normal damage.

notes: I did not author a content JSON/Dhall file because forcing this into MagicItemRecord.passive would lose the on-hit trigger, and forcing it into activation would falsely add a resource-gated use. The closest existing family is mastery.on_hit_trigger, but that family is not available for magic items.
